# VeriNuevo

> Independent, bilingual (EN/ES) car-buying channel: short fact-checked walkarounds of new 2026 cars, focused on details buyers often miss. Not affiliated with any automaker or dealer.

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@VeriNuevo

## Reviews
- [What do most people miss on the 2026 Buick Envision Sport Touring?](https://toddrosenthal7-glitch.github.io/verinuevo/reviews/buick-envision-2026/): A walkaround of five details on the 2026 Buick Envision Sport Touring that shoppers often walk past, checked against Buick's published information. Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7rEFgT8egBQ (Spanish: https://toddrosenthal7-glitch.github.io/verinuevo/es/reviews/buick-envision-2026/)
- [Which 2026 GMC Sierra Denali engine fits you: 3.0 Duramax or 6.2 V8?](https://toddrosenthal7-glitch.github.io/verinuevo/reviews/gmc-sierra-denali-2026/): Two real 2026 GMC Sierra 1500 Denalis, a white 6.2L gas V8 and a black 3.0L Duramax diesel. We compare their engine badges and GMC-rated output and explain which ownership questions to ask before buying. Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YhkihnjD_sc (Spanish: https://toddrosenthal7-glitch.github.io/verinuevo/es/reviews/gmc-sierra-denali-2026/)
- [What should you check on the 2026 Toyota RAV4?](https://toddrosenthal7-glitch.github.io/verinuevo/reviews/toyota-rav4-2026/): Four everyday details on the redesigned 2026 Toyota RAV4 worth checking before you buy. Equipment can vary by trim. Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7UWtrW1qVnY (Spanish: https://toddrosenthal7-glitch.github.io/verinuevo/es/reviews/toyota-rav4-2026/)
